text:
Alex K: Quick check-in — we've seen a pattern where attribution drops for chunked requests when prefix caching returns from the KV layer. Repro in staging: ~0.5% of tokens end up with no provenance_id in downstream billing events.
Maria T: Ugh. Can you paste a minimal repro and the logs you saw? Is this only with chunked uploads or all streaming paths?
Alex K: Only observed with chunked requests + cached prefix reuse. Streaming with fresh prefixes looks fine. Logs show finalizer receives events with provenance_id=null and source=\"kv-prefix-cache\". Example excerpt:
```
INFO finalizer: received event {request_id: "r_42", provenance_id: null, source: "kv-prefix-cache", shard: 3}
```
Dan P: Sounds like the cache return path is not copying the provenance header into the per-chunk envelope. Quick mitigation: when we hydrate from KV, synth a provenance stub if missing and mark as \"synthetic-provenance\" so audit can treat it specially.
Sophie L: That will help billing continuity, but we need to be explicit in docs and audits. Synthetic IDs should never be used to attribute charges without reconciliation.
Maria T: Agreed. Do we have an easy place to attach the header? The runtime attach point is in the tokenizer-level fanout. I can patch the KV hydration shim to ensure it injects provenance_id if absent.
Alex K: If we do inject, we should also set a flag provenance_origins=[\"kv-hydrate\"] in the envelope so downstream can prefer original provenance when available. Rough envelope sketch I sent to Dan:
```
{
  "envelope": {
    "request_id": "r_42",
    "provenance_id": "pv_abcdef123",
    "provenance_origins": ["kv-hydrate"],
    "chunks": [...]
  }
}
```
Dan P: That sketch looks fine. Tradeoffs: extra metadata increases event size ~+120 bytes which impacts egress and Kafka storage. But much cheaper than losing attribution and doing backfills.
Sophie L: Also need to update billing reconciler: treat events with provenance_origins containing \"kv-hydrate\" as lower confidence and surface to ops for spot-checks. We can add a confidence field: confidence: "synthetic"|"native".
Maria T: For audits, can we sample both synthetic and native events and run a post-hoc attribution join using the finalizer's token-time index? Might be heavy.
Alex K: Proposal: short-term (hotfix): patch KV hydrate shim to inject provenance_id + provenance_origins and set confidence="synthetic". Long-term: RFC to unify provenance propagation across runtime components and remove any code-path that can swallow headers.
Dan P: Long-term items: 1) explicit provenance contract in ingest API (required header), 2) runtime enforcement (fail fast if absent unless a controlled shim is enabled), 3) compact provenance registry storing only id -> minimal fingerprint to keep index small.
Sophie L: Operationally we should add alerting on finalizer for >0.1% null-provenance over 1h window and a playbook for investigating. Also a metric for synthetic vs native attribution percentages.
IngestBot: Incident alert generated: metric(finalizer.null_provenance_rate) = 0.52% at 2026-03-21T14:02:13Z ; ticket created #ING-3982
Maria T: I'll open a small PR for the KV shim now and add a test that simulates chunk replay. Alex, can you own the follow-up RFC doc outlining the contract + storage sizing? I can help with unit tests and rollout plan.
Alex K: Yep will draft RFC. For rollout: enable shim by default in staging/qa, gated rollout to prod with a canary, and add a reconciliation job to retroactively stitch provenance for the last 48h if needed.
Dan P: One more thought — for expensive backfills we can do a best-effort attribution by joining request fingerprints with model telemetry to produce estimated token assignments. Flag as estimated in billing exports.
Sophie L: Sounds good. TL;DR action items: Maria patch KV hydrate shim (hotfix), Alex RFC + reconciliation plan, Dan sketches registry and best-effort backfill workflow, Ops adds alert + dashboards. @channel please react with :thumbsup: if that's correct.
Alex K: Thanks everyone. I'll post RFC link once drafted and set a 48h target for the hotfix deploy to staging.
